# R749SML — Minimal Walsh source carrier for a selectable pair of noise-order observers

Date: 2026-11-13 (Asia/Shanghai). Researcher: EM-DIRECT-6AE686; Activity: RA-3D7D1D5110B14FFB53719A3F.
Frozen scientific input: awdawmip/enterprise-math@a72226e2430ffa4786321ac86e7f0c599d5f0389. Continuation of R749SMG–R749SMK in PR #2193, especially R749SMK at c237ff17bf36b7ea7434ec6ad62922ad06039768.

Status: author-side algebraic theorem with exact rational checks, pending independent scientific review. Scope is an eight-source **conditional** signed-Port observer, not a native V29/V39 event. P000 and native X6 geometry remain unchanged.

## Precise model and joint-carrier theorem

The historical source is z=(x,y,t) in {−1,+1}^3. The publicly observed word is (u,v,w) in {−1,+1}^3. Write z_+=y and z_−=t. For all real alpha,beta,gamma in [−1,1], define two column-stochastic likelihood kernels (rows are output words, columns are sources):

\[
F_{uvw,xyz}=\frac{(2+\alpha ux)(2+\beta v z_u)(2+\gamma wyt)}{64},\qquad
P_{uvw,xyz}=\frac{2+\gamma wyt}{128}\sum_{i=\pm1}(2+ix)(1+\alpha ui)(2+\beta v z_i).
\]

F places the A noise before the named-Port B selection; P chooses the Port internally before the noisy A readout. The **future controller may choose either F or P**, and the identity of the chosen experiment is public. The same arbitrary strictly positive source prior must support both public word laws. Stack the likelihood matrices as J=[F;P], a 16×8 matrix.

**Theorem.** For every alpha,beta,gamma in [−1,1], the exact joint rank r=rank(J), and the minimal number c of independent affine source expectations required to predict both experiments, are

\[
r=\begin{cases}
(1+\mathbf1_{\alpha\ne0})(1+\mathbf1_{\gamma\ne0}),&\beta=0,\\
5,&\beta\ne0,\gamma\ne0,\alpha=0,\\
8,&\beta\ne0,\gamma\ne0,\alpha\ne0,\\
4,&\beta\ne0,\gamma=0,\alpha\in\{0,1\},\\
6,&\beta\ne0,\gamma=0,\alpha\notin\{0,1\},
\end{cases}\qquad \boxed{c=r-1}.
\]

In particular, if beta≠0, gamma=0 and alpha∉{0,1}, both F and P *individually* have rank 4 (three moments each) but their joint rank is **6** (five moments). The sharp joint carrier can be chosen as E[X], E[Y], E[T], E[XY], E[XT]. At alpha=0,beta≠0,gamma=0 the sharp carrier is E[Y], E[T], E[X(Y−T)] (joint rank 4); at alpha=0,beta*gamma≠0 it adds E[YT] (joint rank 5).

## Full proof by source Walsh row spaces

Use the eight-dimensional function space on (x,y,t) with Walsh basis {1,x,y,t,xy,xt,yt,xyt}; write eta=yt. If gamma=0, w is a fair independent bit, so calculate the (u,v) marginal row span S. If gamma≠0, variation of w extracts both S and eta*S, hence the full row span is S+eta*S. This is valid at all parameter endpoints, including gamma=±1, since the two w coefficients differ by a nonzero gamma.

When beta=0, the second bit is a fair coin; F=P has row span generated by (2+alpha ux)(2+gamma w eta), yielding independent tensor factors {1,x} when alpha≠0 and {1,eta} when gamma≠0. This gives the first case.

Assume beta≠0 and put f_+=2+alpha*x, f_−=2−alpha*x. Varying v=±1 gives the feedback base span

\[
S_F=\operatorname{span}\{f_+,f_-,f_+y,f_-t\}.
\]

For P the B-dependent row is proportional to

\[
H_u=(2+x)(1+\alpha u)y+(2-x)(1-\alpha u)t;
\]
thus S_P=span{f_+,f_-,H_+,H_-}. For alpha≠0, the two H rows separate into (2+x)y and (2−x)t, whence

\[
S_P=\operatorname{span}\{1,x,(2+x)y,(2-x)t\},\quad
S_F=\operatorname{span}\{1,x,(2+\alpha x)y,(2-\alpha x)t\}.
\]

In each independent 2D Walsh sector {y,xy} and {t,xt}, the two coefficient vectors have determinant proportional to 1−alpha. They coincide when alpha=1, and span each 2D sector when alpha≠1. Together with {1,x}, this yields base joint dimension 4 when alpha=1, and 6 whenever alpha≠0,1.

For alpha=0, S_F=span{1,y,t}, whereas H_+=H_- = 2(y+t)+x(y−t). Therefore

\[
S_F+S_P=\operatorname{span}\{1,y,t,x(y-t)\},
\]
of dimension 4. These settle the gamma=0 cases.

For gamma≠0 and beta≠0, alpha≠0, the feedback kernel itself has full rank eight: for each public u the v and w variations give the entire source sector f_u*span{1,y,t,yt}, since z_u= y or t and z_u*yt is the other sign. The two factors f_+,f_- are independent and span {1,x}. Hence the joint rank is 8. If alpha=0, multiplication by eta on the preceding base span only adjoins yt: eta*y=t, eta*t=y, eta*x(y−t)=−x(y−t). The full joint span is {1,y,t,yt,x(y−t)}, of dimension 5. All cases are proved.

For **sharp affine minimality**, note that the constant source function 1 is in the joint row space because either likelihood matrix is stochastic. A basis for the joint row space modulo constants gives c=r−1 sufficient expectation coordinates. Fewer affine coordinates have an unobserved nonzero signed direction with total mass zero; a sufficiently small plus/minus perturbation of the uniform strictly positive prior retains identical compressed coordinates but changes a J row probability. Thus at least r−1 are required.

## Positive-prior witnesses: why either single kernel loses information

Fix alpha=−1, beta=1/2, gamma=0. Let h_F=y(1+2x) and h_P=y(1−2x), and for either h set

\[
\mu_{h,\pm}(x,y,t)=\frac{1\pm h(x,y,t)/6}{8}.
\]

All probabilities lie in [1/16,3/16]. Exact Walsh orthogonality and complete distribution sums give

\[
TV(F\mu_{h_F,+},F\mu_{h_F,-})=0,\quad
TV(P\mu_{h_F,+},P\mu_{h_F,-})=1/24,
\]
\[
TV(F\mu_{h_P,+},F\mu_{h_P,-})=1/24,\quad
TV(P\mu_{h_P,+},P\mu_{h_P,-})=0.
\]

Indeed h_F is orthogonal to (2−x)y in the F span but not to (2+x)y in the P span, and h_P has the reverse property. Thus both source histories require additional joint moments; the five-coordinate carrier repairs them exactly in this observer scope. This establishes a strict source-provenance preservation condition for a selectable noise-placement control family.

## Exact checker, observed coverage, and continuation

Companions: R749SML_JOINT_OBSERVER_EXACT_CHECK.py and R749SML_JOINT_OBSERVER_RESULTS.json. Python standard-library Fraction Gauss-Jordan checker executed with PASS on all 125 parameter triples from {−1,−1/2,0,1/2,1}³, covering 2,000 normalized source columns, 375 independent rank assertions (F,P,J), three explicit Walsh basis certificates and both positive-prior total-variation identities. The joint rank distribution was {1:1,2:8,4:24,5:16,6:12,8:64}. The finite grid is a consistency check; the argument above establishes the theorem for all real parameters in the stated cube.

**Next scientific unit:** When a finite-memory controller chooses F/P conditioned on earlier *public* output symbols, form its guarded observation transition operators and calculate the minimal multi-step predictive Walsh space. Test whether the rank-six one-step joint carrier is preserved under a two-step policy, or exhibit and repair the first extra history-sign moment. Native V29/V39 port-event correspondence remains a separate exact permission and mapping problem. Shared triadic X6 task has another live owner; no CLAIM change is requested here.
